readme.summary: IOC for UltimaSMS Android A total of 151 UltimaSMS applications have been identified by Gen Threat Labs, of which 82 are on the Google Play Store as of 19-10-21. Sensor Tower data estimates a total of 10.5M downloads of these applications. [PDF format](https://github.com/gendigitalinc/ioc/blob/master/UltimaSMS/UltimaSMSIOC19-10-2021.pdf) [CSV format](https://github.com/gendigitalinc/ioc/blob/master/UltimaSMS/UltimaSMSIOC19-10-2021.csv)
